# Exhibit On Superior

> Luxury River North Chicago apartment community at 165 W Superior St, Chicago IL 60654. Studio, 1BR, 2BR, and 3BR homes.

## Key Pages

- [Home](https://www.rentatexhibit.com/): Community overview and lifestyle highlights
- [Available Units & Floor Plans](https://www.rentatexhibit.com/available-units): Studio, 1, 2, and 3-bedroom layouts and current availability
- [Amenities](https://www.rentatexhibit.com/amenities): Full-floor amenity deck, pool, fitness, dog spa
- [Pet Friendly](https://www.rentatexhibit.com/pet-friendly): Dog- and cat-friendly community with on-site pet amenities
- [Neighborhood](https://www.rentatexhibit.com/neighborhood): River North location near dining, parks, West Loop
- [Schedule a Tour](https://www.rentatexhibit.com/schedule-a-tour): Book an in-person or virtual tour
- [Contact Us](https://www.rentatexhibit.com/contact-us): Phone 312-450-0635, email exhibit@highlandptrs.com
